notes: אַשְׁרֵי takes the construction-supplied copula while its suffix keeps only *thou* (rule 20); the vocative takes the supplied *O* (rule 36).

בֶּן־חוֹרִים has no article morpheme, so the construct takes a supplied *the* and the rectum the relational *of* (rules 19, 29). Both assimilated articles go `unrepresented`, the ASV writing *in due season* and *for drunkenness* (rules 12, 29).
עֵת → *due season* heads on *season*, the supplied word being the modifier here (rule 31, תַּנִּין → *sea monsters* shape).
Margin (*a free man*) read and set aside (rule 38).
